request_sha256_method: SHA-256 of UTF-8 JSON using sort_keys=True and separators=(',', ':')

official_pose_model.hash_source: Exact locked Git blob bytes and LF checkout

notes: table height is confirmed mid-marker z in L_arm_root

obstacles.operator_confirmed_note: field visual confirm of overlay registration; source localize file left unchanged
obstacles.calibration_sha256_encoding: CRLF bytes reconstructed from the Git blob
obstacles.block_geometry: Oriented cubes at 212725 centers and quaternions

place_clearance.method: Euclidean XY distance from locked L8 place_ready to each 212725 block center

collision.geometry: Convex hull enclosing all vertices and triangles of each hash-verified manufacturer STL
collision.clearance_basis: Conservative separation by a unit-axis projection at each joint-linear subinterval midpoint, minus the maximum displacement of both moving link surfaces (one moving link for a static obstacle).
collision.candidate_interpolation: Three Cartesian references sampled at at most 1 mm, solved by bounded URDF IK. Offline speed and clearance apply to the joint-linear interpolation between these samples.
collision.model_mapping_check: Exact matching joint origins and origin rotations, opposite axes and zero offsets.
scope_limitations: P7 left-arm links L1 through L8, table planes, and all ten 212725 block models
Hand, carried payload, camera, torso and right arm are outside the collision model
Table and C35 poses are FIT_ONLY. The 50 mm block edge is an assumption.
Intersections and clearances are reported for the declared offline model

h_checker.request_input: Temporary canonical-byte encoding of the unchanged official JSON
h_checker.arrival_fk_source: Locked URDF. The H checker checks place_ready; intermediate boundaries are checked in phases.
